directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。

entries.EN: Mole, I checked out your lead, found this flash drive inside... What do you think it's about?
entries.JA_current: Mole, I checked out your lead, found this flash drive inside... What do you think it's about?
entries.JA_new: モグラ、教えてもらった場所を調べたら、USBメモリが出てきた。これ、何だと思う？

entries.EN: Oh, yeah? Well, let me see... Right. Marked One, you're in luck! This flash drive is one of the Wanderer's legendary caches, they contain clues on locating his main stash! What was on it?
entries.JA_current: Oh, yeah? Well, let me see... Right. Marked One, you're in luck! This flash drive is one of the Wanderer's legendary caches, they contain clues on locating his main stash! What was on it?
entries.JA_new: そうか？ちょっと見せてくれ……なるほど。マークド・ワン、ついてるぞ！これはワンダラーが残した伝説の隠し物資の一つだ。主な隠し場所を探す手がかりが入ってる。中身は何だった？

entries.EN: Nothing substantial, just a random combination of letters and numbers. Maybe the data on it is damaged or corrupted?
entries.JA_current: Nothing substantial, just a random combination of letters and numbers. Maybe the data on it is damaged or corrupted?
entries.JA_new: 大したものはないよ。適当な英数字が並んでるだけだ。データが壊れてるのかもしれない。

entries.EN: No, this is not an ordinary flash drive, it's been modified with write protection which means you can only write data to it once and it is entirely resistant to data corruption. This random sequence of characters is part of an encryption key which will actually self-assemble and auto-decrypt when plugged into a PDA. Collecting all of these keys and uploading them into your PDA along with the executables on each drive will eventually give you the location of the stash and the key to whatever riches are within, remember that, Marked One.

entries.JA_new: いや、普通のUSBメモリじゃない。書き込み保護を施してあって、データを書き込めるのは一度だけだ。データが壊れる心配もない。この文字列は暗号鍵の一部で、PDAにつなげば自動で組み上がって解読される。各ドライブにある実行ファイルと一緒に、鍵を全部PDAへ取り込めば、隠し場所と中の財宝を手に入れる鍵が分かる。忘れるなよ、マークド・ワン。

entries.EN: Who is this Wanderer and how do you know all this?
entries.JA_current: Who is this Wanderer and how do you know all this?
entries.JA_new: そのワンダラーって何者だ？どうしてそこまで知ってる？

entries.EN: There's a popular tale doing rounds around here about a stalker who somehow managed to slip past the Scorcher, made it all the way to the Wish Granter and asked to become rich. The Granter made sure that he never ran out of money, but in return it took away his ability to enjoy this new wealth... After that, the poor guy didn't last long. Rumor has it that he wandered the Zone aimlessly for some time, all over the place, and before he died he hid an enormous amount of money somewhere and had the location encrypted and divided into seven parts, so that no one could ever hope to find it. Whoever manages to collect all the pieces, can find the treasure. I like clear, straightforward and instructive legends like this. Naturally, there's been no shortage of stalkers who believe it, and have kept their eyes peeled for anything of the sort, but nothing has come of it. You may just be the first to come across one of these keys.

entries.JA_new: ブレイン・スコーチャーを抜けて、願望機のところまでたどり着き、金持ちにしてくれと願ったストーカーの話が広まってる。願望機は金に困らないようにしてやったが、その代わり、手に入れた金を楽しむ心を奪った……哀れな男は長くはもたなかったらしい。噂じゃ、そいつはしばらくゾーン中をあてもなく歩き回り、死ぬ前に大金をどこかへ隠した。場所を7つに分けて暗号化し、誰にも見つからないようにしたんだと。断片を全部集めれば、宝を見つけられるってわけだ。こういう筋が通ってて、役にも立つ伝説はいいな。信じて手がかりを探し回ったストーカーは山ほどいたが、誰も見つけられなかった。あんたがその鍵を最初に見つけたのかもしれないな。
